<?php
class StartNanReferenceIterator20 implements Iterator {
    public float $more = NAN;
    public function rewind(): void { echo 'W|'; }
    #[ReturnTypeWillChange]
    public function &valid() { return $this->more; }
    public function current(): mixed { echo 'C|'; return 7; }
    public function key(): mixed { echo 'K|'; return 0; }
    public function next(): void { echo 'N|'; $this->more = 0.0; }
}
$pack = new StartNanReferenceIterator20;
$target = new Fiber(static function ($value = 'D') {
    echo 'B', $value, '|';
    return 17;
});
set_error_handler(static function ($severity, $message, $file, $line) {
    global $pack;
    echo $severity, '|', $message, '|', $line, '|';
    $pack->more = 0.0;
    return true;
});
$target->start(
    ...$pack
);
restore_error_handler();
echo $target->getReturn();
purpose: Reference valid() payload is reread after warning-handler mutation to float zero.

<?php
class StartParkedNanIterator20 implements Iterator {
    public float $more = NAN;
    public function rewind(): void { echo 'W|'; }
    #[ReturnTypeWillChange]
    public function &valid() { return $this->more; }
    public function current(): mixed { echo 'C|'; return 7; }
    public function key(): mixed { echo 'K|'; return 0; }
    public function next(): void { echo 'N|'; $this->more = 0.0; }
}
$pack = new StartParkedNanIterator20;
$more =& $pack->more;
$weak = WeakReference::create($pack);
$target = new Fiber(static function ($value = 'D') {
    echo 'B', $value, '|';
    return 17;
});
$parent = new Fiber(static function () {
    global $pack, $target;
    set_error_handler(static function ($severity, $message, $file, $line) {
        echo $severity, '|', $message, '|', $line, '|';
        Fiber::suspend('pause');
        return true;
    });
    $target->start(
        ...$pack
    );
    restore_error_handler();
    return 23;
});
echo $parent->start(), '|', (int)$target->isStarted(), '|',
    (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
$pack = null;
$more = 0.0;
echo (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
$parent->resume();
echo (int)($weak->get() === null), '|', $target->getReturn(), '|', $parent->getReturn();
purpose: A parked handler retains raw reference and iterator data after the source CV changes to null.

<?php
class StartThrownNanIterator20 implements Iterator {
    public float $more = NAN;
    public function rewind(): void { echo 'W|'; }
    #[ReturnTypeWillChange]
    public function &valid() { return $this->more; }
    public function current(): mixed { echo 'C|'; return 7; }
    public function key(): mixed { echo 'K|'; return 0; }
    public function next(): void { echo 'N|'; $this->more = 0.0; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'D|'; }
}
$target = new Fiber(static function ($value = 'D') { return 17; });
$weak = WeakReference::create($target);
$start = $target->start(...);
$original = new Exception('warning');
set_error_handler(static function ($severity, $message, $file, $line) use ($original) {
    echo $severity, '|', $message, '|', $line, '|';
    throw $original;
});
try {
    $start(
        ...new StartThrownNanIterator20
    );
} catch (Throwable $error) {
    echo (int)($error === $original), '|', (int)$target->isStarted(), '|';
}
restore_error_handler();
unset($target);
echo (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
unset($start);
echo (int)($weak->get() === null);
purpose: A thrown warning handler retires temporary iterator before pending direct start Closure cleanup without target entry.
